physics_features.displacement_source: Original zero-start physical_u_mm.npy from each completed, true-converged approximate P2 baseline; no GT displacement and no FNO-warm endpoint
physics_features.derivative: G_ij=sum_a u_ai * grad_x_j(N_a), strain=(G+G^T)/2; gradients in original physical mm
physics_features.tensor: sigma=2*mu*strain+lambda*trace(strain)*I, MPa; tensor shear, six slots xx,yy,zz,xy,xz,yz
physics_features.quadrature: Reuse accepted four-Q physical gradients and positive weights, no operator rebuilding, no K guards repeated and no new solve
physics_features.cell_readout: Physical quadrature-weighted mean tensor; cell volume=sum_Q weight
physics_features.node_readout: Incident-cell volume/10 positive weights at each of all ten TET10 nodes, normalize over incident cells; full original row order
physics_features.missing_incident_cells: Keep original nodes with validity=0; six tensor slots zero means missing, never a physical zero-stress claim
physics_features.tensor_normalization: Fit six FP64 means/std on valid TRAIN3 nodes only, std floor1e-8 MPa; normalized invalid slots remain zero; persist and share both arms
physics_features.original_scalar_semantics: Original signed stress MPa is preserved. Constitutive tensor is an explicitly approximate input proxy; no assumed von-Mises scalar, sign rule, exporter or OptiStruct recovery formula

neural.input: xyz3 + original BC/material25 + shared PointNet global32 + six tensor slots + validity1
neural.control_slots: Six exact zero slots, same physical validity mask as tensor arm
neural.geometry: Same original quadratic-boundary node cloud, seed2026,1024 nodes, PointNet32/point_width64; input-only
neural.model: Fresh scalar MLP, four hidden layers256 ReLU, output1, same creation order/state and parameter layout in both arms; encoder trained with head
neural.case_order: 40 balanced shuffled passes of TRAIN3 from independent Python Random(2026); persist exact same order for both arms
neural.loss: Full original case-node mean scalar encoded squared error, node-count-weighted chunk backward before exactly one optimizer step
neural.stress_scaler: TRAIN3-only abs-stress q90 scale floor1e-12MPa, original signed asinh(S/scale), TRAIN mean/std floor1e-8; common two arms, no validation fit
neural.endpoint: Fixed120 updates only, no DEV-best, seed/width/loss/budget rescue; budget-limited endpoints explicitly incomplete
neural.precision: FP32 model/TF32 matching prior pointwise screen, no autocast; feature construction and physical scalar decoding FP64
neural.resume: Preserve optimizer/model/RNG/step and cumulative arm/stage costs; no budget reset
neural.first_real_backward: Actual first full-case update checks finite present gradients and nonzero encoder/head norms; zero-input column gradients may be zero and are not missing

label_access.TRAIN_stress_reads: One actual canonical stress member read per TRAIN3, shared across both arms and stress scaler
label_access.DEV_stress_reads: Only after both arms have persisted predictions for both complete original-node DEV cases; one actual read per DEV2 shared for metrics
label_access.scaler_fits: Two distinct TRAIN-only fits: tensor6 input normalization and signed scalar output scaler; never reused broad40TRAIN fitted scalers

budgets.includes: Actual metadata/input/cache loads, feature recovery and guards, scalers/model/training, endpoint inference/decoding/persistence, deferred stress read/metrics
budgets.after_expiry: No new case/update; save finite checkpoint, explicit budget state and finite endpoint overshoot; no retries with increased budgets

comparison.zero_reference: relativeL2 null with separate finite RMSE/max, do not replace denominator
comparison.tensor_arm_full_cold_cost: Physical baseline GT-free cold solve/setup + actual tensor recovery + model load + target-free neural input preparation + full-node inference/decoding
comparison.direct_arm_cold_cost: Direct target-free neural input preparation + cell-incidence validity mask + model load + full-node inference/decoding. Direct deployment does not require physical solve or tensor recovery; shared experiment feature preparation is not charged as direct method work
comparison.validity_mask_cost: Build once from original cells10 incidence before tensor recovery and time separately; same mask must match positive-volume tensor coverage. Direct mask needs topology, not physical displacement or gradients
comparison.cost_selection: Accuracy-screen gate only; physical cold cost roughly77-101s remains an explicit penalty, no claim of faster than FNO or engineering qualification
comparison.failed_gate: Close this frozen rough stress-readout recipe without width/seed/loss/sign-rule sweeps; choose a different macro solver question
comparison.scope_limit: TRAIN3/DEV2/ver rough input-information screen, not universal geometry/load generalization, no family-wide elimination or final four-field choice
